subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that the recovery carrier fixes landed?
rationale: The recovery fixes are already on main, but the unresolved prevention path changes Anthropic thinking replay semantics and overlaps active PRs with compatibility risk.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and its focused PR path.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat recovery carrier fixes as the near-term fix and defer replay-prevention behavior to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the issue-level split between landed recovery and still-open prevention explicit in the discussion.
